## Our Top Picks in Detail

### 1. Fellow Stagg EKG - Best Overall

The Fellow Stagg EKG is the most beautiful electric kettle on the market. The matte finish comes in nine colors, and the minimalist design fits any kitchen. The PID temperature control maintains accuracy within 1 degree Fahrenheit. The 60-minute keep-warm function ensures your water is ready whenever you are. At $165, it is an investment but the build quality justifies it.

**Price:** $165.00 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 2. Breville SMART Kettle - Best Smart Features

The Breville SMART Kettle learns your preferences over time. The soft-touch interface displays real-time temperature, and the memory function recalls your last setting. The pre-infusion mode gently saturates tea leaves before full boiling. At $199.95, it is the most feature-rich kettle on this list.

**Price:** $199.95 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 3. Bonavita Variable Temperature - Best Value

The Bonavita Variable Temperature kettle delivers professional-grade temperature control at under $70. The 1000W heater brings water to the desired temperature in under 5 minutes, and the 60-minute keep-warm function maintains consistency.

**Price:** $69.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

### 4. COSORI 1.7L - Best Budget Pick

The COSORI 1.7L offers remarkable value at just $39.99. The 10 temperature presets cover everything from delicate white tea to bold black tea, and the 60-minute keep-warm function is uncommon at this price point.

**Price:** $39.99 | **Where to buy:** [Amazon](https://amazon.com)

---

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: What temperature should I use for different teas?**
A: Green tea: 160-175F, White tea: 175-185F, Oolong: 185-200F, Black tea: 200-212F.

**Q: Is a keep-warm function necessary?**
A: It depends on your habits. If you drink multiple cups over 30+ minutes, keep-warm is invaluable.

**Q: Should I descale my kettle?**
A: Yes, monthly if you have hard water. Use a 50/50 water and white vinegar solution.

---

## Final Verdict

For tea enthusiasts, the **Fellow Stagg EKG at $165** is the best overall choice. For budget buyers, the **COSORI 1.7L at $39.99** delivers excellent performance. And for smart features, the **Breville SMART Kettle at $199.95** is unmatched.
